runbook_name: SHS Operator Runbook V1 - Phase 9: Upgrade Opportunity
goal: Document how SHS identifies, tracks, and converts upgrade opportunities.
entry_condition: Phase 7 ClientOps status is actively managed and a trigger event, ClientOps signal, health/report signal, support trend, client request, or operator observation suggests additional value that is not already covered by an active ticket, maintenance item, or approved proposal.
exit_condition: Upgrade tracked or closed: trigger event, ClientOps signal, health/report signal if applicable, recommended upgrade, revenue opportunity, proposal next step, follow-up status, owner, next action, and tracked/closed state are recorded.

surfaces.purpose: Tracks active records, maintenance, support tickets, system health, version history, upgrade opportunities, monthly review, and exports.
Supports monthly review and upgrade opportunity exports.
Tracks opportunity title, type, stage, estimated value, urgency, deadline, buyer, next action, score, and recommended partners.
Tracks sales stages, estimated value, priority, due date, related opportunity, next action, notes, and sales review events.
Trust-aware report and readiness context when an upgrade is based on report signal.
Truth/readiness/public approval authority when upgrade claims become report, proposal, or public-facing claims.

current_upgrade_context.boundary: Upgrade opportunities begin as private SHS operational signals and become sales/proposal work only after operator review and owner-approved next action.

trigger_events: Client asks for a new page, module, report, automation, integration, or workflow.
Support tickets repeat around the same issue.
Maintenance board reveals recurring manual work.
System health review identifies fragility, missing monitoring, or performance risk.
Monthly review shows expansion need or client growth.
Report delivery identifies a better client-facing package.
Version history shows repeated patching that should become a formal upgrade.
Operator identifies a value gap during ClientOps review.

health_report_signal: Truth/readiness gap affecting a client-facing report.

revenue_opportunity_fields: Revenue type: one-time, monthly, annual, retainer, support tier, package upgrade, or unknown.
Confidence: low, medium, high, or unknown.
operator_checklist: Confirm the client is actively managed in ClientOps.
Confirm the signal is not already covered by an active support ticket, maintenance item, or approved proposal.
Document the client value and current limitation.
Estimate revenue opportunity or mark unknown.
Assign owner and proposal next step.
Set follow-up status and next action date.
If client-facing claims are included, check Reports and Truth Spine readiness.
If moving to sales, create or update Hub Opportunities or Hub Sales Pipeline context.
If not moving forward, close with reason.
Exit only when the opportunity is tracked for next action or closed.

blocked_actions: Be represented as approved proposals before owner approval.
Use unverified public claims as sales facts.
Bypass Truth Spine or Reports readiness when used in client-facing reports.
governance_boundary.allowed_conversion_path: Upgrade opportunities may become proposal or report candidate material only through the appropriate sales, reporting, privacy, ownership, and governance gates.

definition_of_done: Health/report signal is recorded or marked not applicable.
Revenue opportunity is estimated or marked unknown.
Owner and next action are assigned unless closed.
Opportunity is tracked in ClientOps, Hub Opportunities, or Hub Sales Pipeline when moving forward.
Final status is Upgrade tracked or closed.
findings: ClientOps audit identifies upgrade opportunities as a ClientOps functional area.
Phase 8 reporting already treats upgrade reports as recommendations, not commitments, until approved through sales, proposal, governance, and delivery flow.
Hub Opportunities and Hub Sales Pipeline provide existing SHRV1 context for opportunity and proposal follow-up.
ClientOps upgrade signals are internal/private and should not become public SHF data or public claims without governance.
Upgrade conversion is currently operator-driven and not hard runtime-enforced in SHRV1.
launch_blockers: No dedicated SHRV1 upgrade opportunity conversion route was identified.
No automated ClientOps upgrade-to-Hub Opportunity conversion exists in SHRV1.
Revenue estimate and proposal next step are checklist-driven rather than hard-validated.
ClientOps upgrade records currently rely on the consumer app context and manual operator workflow.
Production auth and durable opportunity persistence remain post-V1.
post_v1_improvements: Add a structured upgrade opportunity model when owner approves runtime work.
Add one-click conversion from ClientOps upgrade opportunity to Hub Opportunity or Sales Pipeline item.
Add proposal readiness fields and owner approval state.
Add revenue range and confidence validation.
Add governed report/proposal package generation for accepted upgrade opportunities.
